item.title: Ask HN: How to Stay Marketable in the AI Era?
item.summary: I've got a CS degree and I'm working as a mid-level full stack developer. An unfortunate part of my career is being based in Iraq where almost no developer job exists, even if it did the competition would be crazy. I want to learn something new even if not software development related that should keep me marketable more than being a developer. But what!
